name: B10-0089/2026 (S&D) – Presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament recognises Nasry Asfura as the winner of Honduras's presidential election on 30 November 2025. It calls on the current government to accept the result instead of demanding a recount, which the electoral council says is unconstitutional. It condemns intimidation and attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly. It urges all political actors to avoid inflammatory speech and disinformation, and asks Honduras to keep its electoral bodies, courts and prosecutors independent. It also calls on other countries not to interfere. This is a statement of position, not a law.

- The Parliament backs Asfura's win and urges the government to accept it; this affects Honduras's government and voters.
- It condemns attacks on opposition assembly members; this concerns Honduran politicians and their safety.
- It asks Honduras to protect courts and media and other countries to stay out; follow-up is up to Honduran authorities.
